_comment: End-of-life / known-weak version table. Matched against the nmap version banner (product + version). Deliberately narrow: every entry must be defensible from the banner alone. These are reported as 'possible' confidence — a banner is a claim by the remote service, not proof. Severity is capped at medium because EOL software is a risk factor, not a confirmed vulnerability.

rules.title: Apache httpd out of date
rules.detail: The banner reports a version below 2.4.58, which predates several fixed security releases in the 2.4 branch.
rules.remediation: Upgrade to the current 2.4.x release, or move to a supported distribution package stream and confirm the vendor backports security fixes.

rules.title: nginx out of date
rules.detail: The banner reports a version below 1.24, which is outside the current stable/mainline support window.
rules.remediation: Upgrade to the current stable release and review the security advisories between the two versions.

rules.title: OpenSSH out of date
rules.detail: The banner reports OpenSSH below 8.0, which is outside support and predates hardening defaults such as disabled ssh-rsa signatures in newer releases.
rules.remediation: Upgrade the SSH daemon, or move to a distribution release that backports fixes. Re-check the negotiated algorithms afterwards.

rules.title: OpenSSL 1.0.x/1.1.0 — obsolete branch
rules.detail: OpenSSL 1.1.0 and older are end-of-life and no longer receive security fixes. Heartbleed (CVE-2014-0160) affects 1.0.1 through 1.0.1f.
rules.remediation: Upgrade to OpenSSL 3.x (or a vendor-supported 1.1.1 build) and restart dependent services.

rules.title: PHP out of date
rules.detail: The banner reports PHP below 8.1, a branch that no longer receives security updates.
rules.remediation: Upgrade to a supported PHP branch (8.2 or newer at time of writing) and re-test the application.

rules.title: Legacy Microsoft IIS version
rules.detail: The banner suggests an IIS version that belongs to an operating system no longer in support.
rules.remediation: Migrate the site to a supported Windows Server release. IIS version is tied to the OS, so this is an OS lifecycle issue.

rules.title: vsftpd out of date
rules.detail: The banner reports vsftpd below 3.0, missing fixes from later releases.
rules.remediation: Upgrade vsftpd, or retire FTP entirely in favour of SFTP.

rules.title: ProFTPD out of date
rules.detail: The banner reports ProFTPD below 1.3.7, which predates a number of security releases.
rules.remediation: Upgrade ProFTPD and review its advisory history for the versions skipped.

rules.title: Samba out of date
rules.detail: The banner reports Samba below 4.15. Older Samba releases have had remotely exploitable flaws, including SambaCry (CVE-2017-7494).
rules.remediation: Upgrade Samba to a current release, disable SMBv1, and restrict shares to required subnets.

rules.title: Exim out of date
rules.detail: The banner reports Exim below 4.95, a period with multiple critical remote code execution fixes.
rules.remediation: Upgrade Exim to a current release and review local configuration for exposed ACLs.

rules.title: Postfix out of date
rules.remediation: Upgrade Postfix via the distribution package stream.

rules.title: UnrealIRCd on a version with a backdoor history
rules.detail: Versions in the 3.2.8.1 line were distributed with a backdoor (CVE-2010-2075). Any pre-5 release warrants manual verification of the binary.
rules.remediation: Rebuild or upgrade to a current release from official sources, and verify the package signature.
